'''Rommus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who served during the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the fighting.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Rommus appears as a Champion boss unrelated to any mission in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. This article assumes full game completion, and thus that Rommus was killed.<ref name="TOR" />
